item.title: Dilnoza's Morning
item.summary: A student describes what she does every morning before her classes.
item.transcript_text: Hello, my name is Dilnoza. I am a student, and I live in Tashkent with my family. I get up at half past six every day. First, I wash my face and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my brother. We eat bread, eggs and cheese, and we drink green tea. At half past seven, I walk to the bus stop. The bus is often full, so I sometimes stand. My classes start at eight o'clock. I like my mornings because they are quiet and calm.
